docs.title: API Documentation
docs.subtitle: Integrate SatsPay into your faucet or app in minutes.

quickstart.text: 1. Generate an API key in Settings → API Keys. 2. Copy the raw key (only shown once). 3. Use it as the x-api-key header on every request. 4. Every /send call must include a unique idempotencyKey so retries don't double-spend.

auth.text: All public API requests require the x-api-key header. The key you receive is a 64-character hex string prefixed with the first 8 chars visible in your key list (so you can identify which key is active without exposing the secret).

send.desc: Send an internal micropayment from your SatsPay balance to another SatsPay user, identified by email.
send.idempotencyNote: The idempotencyKey field ensures at-most-once semantics. Repeating a request with the same key returns { status: "idempotent" } without transferring again.

balance.desc: Fetch balances for all coins associated with the API key owner.
balance.scope: No balance scope is required; any valid API key can read the account balance.

errors.text: Errors follow a consistent shape: { error: { code, message, details? } }. Common codes include UNAUTHORIZED, VALIDATION_ERROR, RATE_LIMITED, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, NOT_FOUND.

limits.text: Public API is rate-limited to 60 requests per minute per API key. Auth endpoints (/auth/login, /auth/register) are limited to 10 requests per 15 minutes per IP.

keys.text: Manage your keys in Settings. You can create keys with specific scopes (deposits, send, history, *) and disable them at any time. The balance endpoint does not check a scope. Keys are stored hashed — the raw value is shown only once, when generated.

devsNote.text: Need to integrate payments into your app?

items.a: Signup and the personal wallet are free: on-chain withdrawals only pay the network fee. On the merchant payment gateway the fee is 0.25% per invoice, deducted from what the merchant receives — the customer pays the full amount.

items.q: How long does a deposit take?
items.a: It depends on confirmations per coin (e.g. BTC/BCH 2, LTC 6, DOGE 20). After that, crediting is automatic.

items.q: Can I hold several coins in one account?
items.a: Yes. BTC, LTC, DOGE and more live in the same SatsPay wallet.
Enter the address and amount. Larger requests may be reviewed before going on-chain.
We keep only what's needed in hot wallet. Large moves are reviewed; the rest stays in cold storage.

sections.title: 1. Controller and DPO (LGPD)
body: SatsPay is the controller of personal data processed on this service (multi-coin wallet, faucet and merchant gateway).
Data-subject requests (access, correction, export, erasure): Settings → Privacy or privacy@satspay.pro. Response window: 15 days (LGPD arts. 18–19).

sections.title: 2. Legal bases and data
body: Contract (art. 7, V): email, username, Argon2 password hash, 2FA, API keys, invoices and webhooks.
Legal duty / rights defense (art. 7, II and VI): ledger entries. Those amounts are not deleted when the account is closed.
Fraud and security (art. 7, IX): IP (may be stored as HMAC), user-agent, captcha, login audit.
Store-customer fields (email, name, callback) are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never shown on the public checkout.
We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: 3. Use and sharing
body: To run wallets, faucet, swap, gateway and authentication.
Necessary processors: Cloudflare Turnstile (captcha), SMTP (email codes), blockchain nodes (public transactions).
On-chain addresses and tx hashes are public by nature of the network.

sections.title: 4. Retention and security
body: Active account: for the life of the contract. After closure: profile anonymized; ledger and invoice amounts remain.
OTPs, captcha tokens and telemetry are short-lived and discarded.
In transit: TLS on the domain. At rest: AES-256-GCM with AAD, searchable email HMAC, hashed API keys.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
body: Access and portability: GET /v1/me/export (signed-in session) or the button in Settings.
Erasure/anonymization: POST /v1/me/erase with confirmation (email + the word APAGAR). Sessions and keys are revoked.
Correction: username in Settings. Email correction: privacy@satspay.pro.
Withdrawal of consent and sharing info: same channel. Relevant incidents will be notified under art. 48.

sections.title: 6. International transfers
body: Infrastructure may run in multiple regions. We apply safeguards appropriate to the nature of the data transferred.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
body: By creating an account or using SatsPay APIs, you agree to these Terms. If you disagree, do not use the service.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility & accounts
body: You must provide accurate registration information and keep credentials confidential.
You are responsible for all activity under your account and API keys.

sections.title: 3. Service description
body: SatsPay provides custodial micropayment wallets for supported coins (BTC, LTC, DOGE, BCH) and related tools such as faucet, staking, lending, swap, and public APIs.
Features may change; experimental modules can be limited or paused without notice when required for security.

sections.title: 4. Risks & disclaimers
body: Cryptocurrency involves volatility and operational risk. SatsPay is not a bank, broker or investment advisor.
Network fees, confirmation times and chain reorganizations are outside our control.

sections.title: 5. Acceptable use
body: Do not use SatsPay for illegal activity, sanctions evasion, phishing, spam faucets that violate third-party terms, or attempts to disrupt infrastructure.
We may suspend accounts that violate these Terms or create material risk to other users.

sections.title: 6. API use
body: API keys must be stored securely. Rate limits and scopes apply. Idempotency keys are required for send operations.
Abuse of public endpoints may result in key revocation.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of liability
body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, SatsPay is not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from use of the service.
Total liability for any claim related to the service is limited to fees you paid us in the 3 months preceding the claim (if any).

sections.title: 8. Changes
body: We may update these Terms. Material changes will be indicated by updating the "Last updated" date on this page.

sections.title: 1. What are cookies?
body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We may also use local storage for similar purposes (session preferences and consent).

sections.title: 2. Cookies we use
body: Essential: authentication and session cookies (including HttpOnly refresh tokens) required to keep you signed in securely.
Preferences: language and UI mode in local storage so the app remembers your choices.
Consent: a local flag recording that you acknowledged this policy.

sections.title: 3. Analytics & advertising
body: We do not currently set third-party advertising cookies. If we add privacy-respecting analytics later, this page will be updated before activation.

sections.title: 4. Managing cookies
body: You can clear cookies and site data in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent login.
For questions: privacy@bitcosats.com.
